posts.title_en: Entering the Dimensional Rift (with the final climbing decks)
posts.summary_en: 서신우 (Lv.188) graduates the main stages and enters the Rift. His stage presets read 4.08G to 4.15G on the formation screen; inside the Rift at 차원의 힘 Lv.1 his profile header reads 4G 153M 598K with no guild, so header and lobby power agree at Lv.1. He shows the 차원의 힘 Lv.2 effects screen, the Continuum Cog (무한바퀴) pet, and the Rift idle reward (1분당 2개 of the Rift item at level 2). He calls levels 1-3 easy on entry and says the real Rift starts at level 2.

clears.note: 41.5% of recommended on the header figure. The fight is shown at 100% then 97%; the clear itself is implied by his reaching level 2.

cookies.note: Identified by the subtitle naming the preset the 달토끼덱.

mechanics: The Rift header power equals the lobby power at 차원의 힘 Lv.1 (4G 153M 598K against presets of 4.08-4.15G).
rift: 차원의 힘 Lv.2 effects, as shown: Rift ATK, DEF and HP +10%, crit damage +30%, crit rate +10%, focus +5%, accuracy +10%. They equal crumb.gg rift.json's level-2 row.
Continuum Cog (무한바퀴): +50% ally boss damage in the Rift at its shown grade.
The Rift idle reward at level 2 includes a new item at 1 per minute ×2 ('1분 당 2개'), matching rift.json's idle table (level n gives n).

quotes.en: The real thing starts from level 2.
For GingerCraven I used the Moon Rabbit deck.

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 차원의 이면 시즌1 쿨링민트맛 쿠키 공략 (2단계)
posts.summary_en: Level 2, Cool Mint with many adds. The formation screen shows 4.21G (lobby power; no Rift header is shown), so the video carries no Rift bracket. Advice: fight from a corner as usual; Cool Mint is summoned on top of the team at the start, so hold off then and let Scorpion stack. Rye can stand in; without Moon Rabbit, put Armor Repair in the armour perk slot. The boss falls to 0.000% with 7.733 left on the clock.

clears.note: No Rift power shown, so no bracket. His own text gives 5.167G as the level's 35% line 'on the Rift's basis' (nv:49183, DC lane).

teams.name: 서신우 level-2 preset

cookies.note: Low confidence: read from the sprite (white hair, strawberries) against crumblehub's portraits.

teams.why: Rye can replace a dealer; without Moon Rabbit, Armor Repair in the armour slot.
substitutions: Armor Repair perk instead of Moon Rabbit

rift: The figure under the boss bar counts down from about 27.7 and reads 7.733 when the boss dies: the fight clock.

quotes.en: With the Bari deck you just stack on it and it's done.

quotes.kr: 소환된 상태라 평소처럼 구석컨을 하면 답이 없어서 시작하면 바로 겹쳐주는데 그때만 손을 떼서 전갈의 스택을 묻히면서
quotes.en: It's summoned already, so the usual corner play doesn't work; it overlaps you at the start, so take your hand off then and let Scorpion's stacks land.

posts.summary_en: Level 3, the Werehound Princess as on main stages: use the airborne deck. The formation screen shows 4.14G (lobby). He gives the level's line as 6.39G, which is rift-levels.json's 35% line, and says the 차원의 힘 buff raises Rift power enough that levels up to 3 fall easily on entry. Perks: make Milk receive every perk and raise only ATK. The boss reaches 0.000% with 1.733 on the clock.

clears.note: No Rift power shown; by his own words his Rift power cleared the 6.39G (35%) line, so this is most likely a 35% clear.

teams.why: Airborne deck as on the main-stage Werehound Princess; all perks onto Milk, raise only ATK.

quotes.kr: 이것의 권장 전투력은 6.39G인데 차원의 이면에서는 차원의 힘 버프를 받은 덕분에 전투력이 많이 높아지기 때문에 쉽게 잡으실 수 있습니다
quotes.en: Its required power is 6.39G, but in the Rift the 차원의 힘 buff raises your power a lot, so it falls easily.

quotes.kr: 처음 입성하면 3단계까지는 쉽게 잡으실 수 있습니다
quotes.en: On first entering, levels up to 3 are easy.

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 차원의 이면 시즌1 폭주단 트럭 공략 (4단계)
posts.summary_en: Level 4, the truck. Formation screen 4.28G (lobby); the line 'on the Rift's basis' is 7.776G, rift-levels.json's 35% line. The truck hits hard, but in the Rift the perks go as usual: raise Milk's ATK only. Play as on main stages: move a little at a time so the truck's charge distance doesn't build, and don't get hit on the first lure. The truck reaches 0.000% with 4.633 on the clock.

cookies.note: Should survive to use its skill.

quotes.en: On the Rift's basis it is 7.776G.

quotes.kr: 너무 빠르게 이동하면 돌진 거리가 되지 않으니 살짝씩 움직여 주시고
quotes.en: Moving too fast gives it charge distance, so move a little at a time.

posts.summary_en: The Rift's own tables from the client: the damage brackets (dmg: 10% → 5, 20% → 15, 40% → 35, 60% → 55, 80% → 75, 100% → 100, 120% → 120), the 차원의 힘 levels 1-100 with the XP each needs and the stats each grants (Lv.2 +10% ATK/DEF/HP, +30% crit damage, +10% crit, +5% focus, +10% accuracy; each level adds about 10% ATK/DEF/HP, to +990% at Lv.100), the idle gain per Rift level (level n gives n per minute), fragments per level, the reward keys (Continuum Cog at levels 1 and 20) and the seasons.
mechanics: The Rift's damage table is the main stages' table, so a Rift level's 15% bracket starts at 20% of its recommended power and its 35% at 40%.
rift: Idle gain is the Rift level reached per minute, so pushing a level both raises the bracket's reach and speeds up the next 차원의 힘 level.
